name: code4me-ntg
description: Minimal bounded engineering orchestration with Basic Memory and toolbox routing.

interface.shortDescription: Bounded delegation with shared Basic Memory.
interface.longDescription: Code4Me delegates one engineering task when useful, optionally adds one independent verifier, shares durable Basic Memory context, routes toolbox use by question shape, validates correlated results, and provides read-only status and housekeeping over its minimal event trail.
